mentions.name: WatchCat
mentions.description: WatchCat is an uptime and cron monitoring service offering uptime checks, cron/heartbeat monitoring, incident tracking, status pages, and notifications. Built with Rails and hosted in the EU, its goal is to make the familiar "is it actually working?" monitoring simple, reliable, and pleasant to use.
mentions.problem: Covering the boring-but-important "is it actually working?" part of the stack for services and cron jobs, with simple and reliable monitoring.
